description: IIM Lucknow's Lucknow campus is a 200-acre management-education campus at Prabandh Nagar, IIM Road, Lucknow; the official campus page lists postgraduate management programmes and a Fellow Programme.

supports: The 2025 Management ranking directory names Indian Institute of Management Lucknow in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
Official Website of Indian Institute of Management, Lucknow.
Current programme navigation lists MBA, MBA-ABM, MBA-SM, MBA-WE, IPMX (1-Year MBA), bMBA, BS(AI & BA), Ph.D, and Ph.D for working executives.
Identifies Lucknow Campus, its Prabandh Nagar, Lucknow address, 200-acre campus, and programmes at the Lucknow campus.
MBA/Post Graduate Programme, two-year duration, MBA award, and eligibility.
MBA-ABM/Post Graduate Programme in Agribusiness Management, two-year duration, MBA Agribusiness Management award, and eligibility.
MBA-SM/Post Graduate Programme in Sustainable Management, two-year curriculum, and eligibility.
MBA-WE/PGPWE, two-year MBA programme, Noida-campus delivery, and eligibility.
IPMX (1-Year MBA), one-year residential programme at Noida Campus, and eligibility.
bMBA, two-year degree-granting blended MBA programme, and eligibility.
BS(AI & BA), four-year Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence and Business Analytics, and eligibility.

courses.eligibility: Master's degree with at least 55% marks, or engineering/four-year graduate degree with at least 75%, or specified professional qualifications; additional public-examination and category requirements apply on the official page.

agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Management directory directly lists Indian Institute of Management Lucknow in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and the official campus page confirms the Lucknow campus address and identity.

Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'; public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure only after confirming the expected www.nirfindia.org and www.iiml.ac.in hostnames.

The official site distinguishes a Lucknow campus and a Noida campus. MBA-WE and IPMX are explicitly identified as Noida-campus programmes; the institution and district are anchored to the Lucknow campus.

The nine current degree and doctoral programme pages exposed through the official programme navigation were captured. The separate Executive Education catalogue mixes rolling external-provider programmes, certificate-labelled offerings, customized programmes, and short-duration entries with stale or closed dates, so complete current credential coverage cannot be established without guessing; manual review is required.

The IPMX page calls the programme a One-Year MBA but also states that final degree/diploma status depends on an unresolved official engagement. The EFPM page states ordinarily five years and maximum seven years in its eligibility section but contains a separate older FAQ duration reference, reinforcing the manual-review status.
